h1: Lingora payment methods for Yemen, the Gulf, and USDT BEP20
intro: This page lists the methods the project owner supplied for customers in Yemen and the Gulf, plus USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) as an international option. This preview is not ready to accept money: confirm the beneficiary, full destination address, and displayed network before sending funds. Never use an incomplete or unverified address.

sections.heading: Paying from Yemen
paragraphs: According to the project owner, Yemen customers may use Haseb and the Al-Kuraimi Bank accounts shown in the payment cards above. The supplied beneficiary name is also shown there. Before transferring, match the currency, account number, and beneficiary against the final order instructions; stop if any details differ.

The electronic-wallet card lists ONE Cash, Jawali, Jeeb, Floosak, and Cash with the shared number supplied by the owner. Do not assume that every wallet can transfer to every other wallet. Select the exact wallet named in your payment instructions and check that the in-app beneficiary details match before confirming.

sections.heading: Paying from Gulf countries
paragraphs: The project owner listed Mada, Visa, or remittance/bank transfers for Gulf customers. Mada is associated with eligible Saudi-issued cards; Visa or transfers depend on the payment page, the issuing bank, and the provider available to the customer. Use only the method shown in the order instructions. Never send a card number, CVV, or one-time password through chat.

No final currency, card or transfer fees, or country-by-country acceptance tests were supplied. The live payment page should show the amount, currency, beneficiary, and any applicable charges before confirmation. Listing a card brand here is not a guarantee that every card from every Gulf bank will be accepted.

sections.heading: International option: USDT on BEP20
paragraphs: The specified digital-currency option is USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20). It may be usable internationally where local rules permit it and the customer's wallet supports the network. That does not mean it is available without exception in every country or on every exchange; check local rules and wallet access before sending.

Select BNB Smart Chain/BEP20 and send USDT only. Do not substitute ERC20, TRC20, or another network just because the token is also USDT; a network mismatch can make funds unrecoverable. Your wallet may require a balance for network fees, so review its confirmation screen before proceeding.

The complete transfer address has not been approved for publication. The address supplied for review is incomplete, so it is intentionally omitted and must not be used. Do not initiate a transfer until a full, verified destination appears in an approved Lingora payment channel. A screenshot or unverified message is not confirmation that funds arrived.

sections.heading: Before you send any payment
paragraphs: Open the Lingora order instructions and match the payment method, currency, amount, and beneficiary. For a bank or wallet transfer, check the account or wallet number and beneficiary before confirming. For a card payment, enter details only on a trusted payment page; never send your card number, CVV, or one-time code to support.

For USDT, match the token, network, and full destination address character by character. Proceed only when final, verified instructions are available. This preview does not set an exchange rate, fee, confirmation count, or settlement time; the live payment channel must explain those details before transfer. Keep the transaction reference for follow-up, but do not treat a transfer receipt alone as proof of completed payment or subscription activation.

faqs.question: What is the Yemen wallet number?
faqs.answer: Use the number shown in the wallet payment card, then confirm the selected wallet and beneficiary in its app before sending.

faqs.question: Can I send USDT to any BEP20 address I find?
faqs.answer: No. Transfer only after receiving a complete destination through an approved Lingora payment channel, and confirm BNB Smart Chain (BEP20). The address supplied for this draft is incomplete.

faqs.question: Is BEP20 literally available in every country?
faqs.answer: It is an international option for customers with a compatible wallet, but access can be affected by local law and wallet or exchange policies. Availability cannot be guaranteed without exception.

faqs.question: Does Mada work across every Gulf country?
faqs.answer: Mada is associated with Saudi-issued cards. The owner-listed Gulf options are Mada, Visa, or transfers, but final acceptance depends on the payment instructions, bank, and country.
